subject: User clarified Dash: range highlights replace travel-budget accounting
body:
# Dash range clarity

Owner: Codex. User clarification: Dash's internal distance allowance does not need a visible budget because movement is one indivisible action, not a pool spent around other actions.

Exact pre-edit claim: `expeditions/v2/ui/{OrchardExpedition.jsx,MapViewport.jsx,ActionPreview.jsx,movement-view.js,recovery.css.js}`, `scripts/dev/test-orchard-recovery.mjs`, this report and refreshed `dash-map-*`/`dash-preview-*` browser evidence. C-05 lock held. No engine, shared App or legacy edits. Preserve the real reachable set and one-AP action cost; remove cost colours/numerals and budget management copy from the primary movement flow.

Evidence naming before capture: use new `dash-range-*` captures under the existing player-recovery evidence directory to preserve the superseded cost-colour screenshots for comparison.

Additional pre-edit claim: `expeditions/v2/ui/action-guide.js` for replacing the ability hand's budget terminology with reach.

Delivered: a single consistent highlight for all legal destinations, without cost numerals, travel-cost colour classes or a visible movement budget. The compact selector says `1 AP · choose any highlighted hex`. Preview still shows the selected destination/path, actual AP change and ability becoming spent; it omits internal movement-cost/budget factors. Reach still comes from the unchanged production command. Ability descriptions say Speed determines reach. The collapsed coordinate/text alternative remains available.

Checks: `node --test expeditions/v2/ui/ui.test.js scripts/dev/test-orchard-recovery.mjs`: 12 passed. Actual Dash reach, one-AP cost, spent-state behavior, preview purity and production trace/reward checks remain intact. Updated UI assertions verify that neither the selector nor preview presents a movement budget. Isolated QA preview rebuilt; shared App bundles remain untouched.

Actual browser: desktop 1280×900, tablet 768×1024 and phone 390×844 captures in `docs/expeditions/v2/evidence/player-recovery/dash-range-{desktop,tablet,phone}.jpg`; `dash-range-preview-phone.jpg` shows the pure one-AP preview with no distance accounting. Pointer selection of the station hex still opens movement preview directly. Cancel leaves Furrow at 2 AP. Temporary viewport override reset. Earlier cost-colour evidence is superseded by this user clarification.

Scoped change complete. No engine changes or unresolved check failures. Shared App integration stays Claude-owned; wider QA-01 remains pending. New screenshots demonstrate the development controller-route fixture, not integrated account-route or physical-device acceptance.
